name: Secretaría de Movilidad de Bogotá
body: HSTS, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a canonical, and GA4. But its sitemap lists URLs like http://default/ and http://default/en-gb, because the CMS never learned its public address.
lesson: Set the CMS base URL to your public https address, then regenerate the sitemap.
summary: www.movilidadbogota.gov.co scores 75 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 31 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 282 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 282 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: default (282). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.movilidadbogota.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /tramites-y-servicios, /web/SIMUR/excepciones/consultarPlaca/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 2 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: SERVERID, PHPSESSID. Without HttpOnly: PHPSESSID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /transparencia, /tramites-y-servicios and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 21 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 19 indexable pages are missing from the sitemap
fix.fix: Add them to the sitemap or regenerate it on each deploy.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Language alternates point at each other
The start page sets a mobile viewport
